condition: On MSSQL, dropping or altering a column on a table whose name is a reserved word (e.g. user) generates dynamic EXEC('ALTER TABLE user DROP CONSTRAINT ...') without brackets, so it fails with a syntax error.
workaround: Rename the table to a name that isn't a reserved word, or drop the default constraint yourself with knex.raw (e.g. ALTER TABLE [user] DROP CONSTRAINT ...) before calling dropColumn.
